sn32.53:1.1: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenekadā sītaṃ hotīti || || Santi bhikkhu Sītavalāhakā nāma devā || || Tesaṃ yadā evaṃ hoti Yaṃ nuna mayaṃ sakāya ratiyā rameyyāmāti || || tesantaṃ cetopaṇidhim anvāya sītaṃ hoti || || Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenekadā sītaṃ hotīti || Sāvatthi || ||
